@Meta released Muse today, a personal agent competing with Instinct / @TownAI / @bot. One very notable thing it does differently than the rest is payment protection. If you have a "bad bot" moment (and we all will) it will cover you.

quote: Today I set up @TownAI and Instinct @noahrshinn at the same time. The town setup was way better, and the integrations were super easy. The whole thing felt just really powerful. They feel very different from each other, yet I keep going back and forth in my mind as to which I like better. Town feels more professional and powerful, and Instinct feels almost overly simple and yet has a surprising amount of horsepower.
